C ONCLUSION Due t o t he e x istence of noise and uncertainty in sleep-w a k e stage, this study de v e lops a deep TSK f uzzy classier Drrh- TSK-FC to achie v e a n e f cient sleep stage recognition w ith high interpretability . On one hand, Drrh-TSK-FC k eeps the s ame generation o f i nput spaces in its sub-classiers a s i n our pre v ious w o rks s uch that it can well share t he distincti v e adv antage of deep stack ed structures in the s ense o f enhanced performance and in- terpretability . On t he other hand, dif f erent from traditional deep stack ed structures, D rrh-TSK-FC considers t he use o f both s hort fuzzy rules and random rule heritage in its each sub-classier so as to reect the i mportance changes of the f eatures in adjacent sub-classiers and hence mimic human cogniti v e beha vior in le v e raging the past e xperiences to address s imilar p roblems. Besides, D rrh-TSK-FC t ak es a linear ensemble o f a ll the s ub- classiers t o a ssure further impro v e ment in its performance. The e xperimental results sho w that Drrh-TSK-FC i s s uperior to other comparati v e c lassiers f or the t asks of sleep-w a k e stage recognition. There i s a big r oom for t he future study about this w o rk here. F o r e xample, ho w t o determine an appropriate number of randomly inherited r ules or gi v e a guideline about it for v a rious datasets i s w orth y f or study in near future. W hile one may a r gue that the i mportance changes of features should b e better e xpressed b y t heir d if ferent weights r ather than the u se of short f uzzy rules, ho w t o generalize t he use o f s hort f uzzy rules i s another interesting t opic. At present, our study only concentrates o n a linear combination o f a ll the s ub-classiers in Drrh-TSK-FC. Let u s r ecall t hat another tw o commonly used ensemble s trate g ies, i.e., a v eraging and majority v o ting, generally require much less computational b u rden. Therefore, which ensemble s trate g y s hould b e t ak en by Drrh-TSK-FC s o as to achie v e good trade-of f between classication performance and computational b u rden should b e e mpirically studied for v a rious datasets.
